hcn.temperature_fit_anchor: Use the reviewed fit only for its temperature trend, anchored to the separately preferred 298.15 K pKa; the fit alone gives pKa 9.29 at 298.15 K.

ammonium.extended_temperature_note: The constant-heat-capacity extrapolation from the 298.15 K selected values is approximate above 323.15 K; direct enthalpy measurements were reported from 278 to 418 K.

water.ionization_model: IAPWS R11-24 equations 2-4 with liquid-water density

limitations: Ideal dilute activities and no external buffer, strong ions, carbonic acid or other aqueous acid-base pairs are assumed.
This dataset is for post-run liquid-water equilibrium diagnostics, not a calibrated pH or kinetic rate model.
Above 323.15 K, the ammonium pKa temperature adjustment is a constant-heat-capacity estimate rather than a direct reproduction of the full measured high-temperature correlation.
